reader.requirement: At --std 85 a literal integer-1/-3/-4 (and integer-2 for the footing area) is used when OPEN OUTPUT executes and fixes the page body, top and bottom margins and footing area of EVERY logical page the file writes in that execution.
reader.edition-search: Grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|Std over SequentialConnector.cs, LinagePage.cs (no hits), SequentialIoEmitter.cs (one unrelated SELECT WHEN hit), FileRegistry.cs (Edition only for sharing and CLOSE WITH LOCK; SharedOpenAttempt's 'mode == Output -> BeginLinagePage' reads none). LinageOpExpr folds a literal to a C# constant, so every page re-evaluation sees the same value.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb523 (literal 2/3/2 margins on the medium) and pb489 (qualified data-names) exercise the OPEN-time page; a literal page re-applied across several page overflows and ADVANCING PAGE transitions is exercised only by the probes.

probes.printed: LINAGE IS 2 LINES WITH FOOTING AT 1: B0 EOP LC=1, B1 EOP LC=2
probes.expected: literal page of 2, footing 1, applied from OPEN OUTPUT

probes.printed: FD PB LINAGE IS 3 LINES WITH FOOTING AT WS-F2 (=4): B-OPEN FS=90 LC=000, B-W FS=90 LC=000
probes.expected: the literal page size 3 is the one in force at OPEN OUTPUT; a footing beyond it is a program error (undefined at 1985)

probes.printed: OPEN OUTPUT LC=1 then the model drives pages; page model is built only for OPEN OUTPUT (FileRegistry.SharedOpenAttempt mode == Output); OPEN EXTEND of a LINAGE file is barred by §1985:VII.4.3.3 SR3 and was not probed

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR6  (║3.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR6 [quote: These values are used for all logical pages written for that file]

reader.notes: The literal operands render as constants into the LinagePage passed by every OPEN and WRITE, so every page re-evaluation (BeginNextLogicalPage -> EvaluateLinage) re-establishes the same geometry; the page model is built only after a successful OPEN OUTPUT. No edition is consulted on this path.
